a token pattern for people with academic titles: a title, followed by # the first token of a person the model recognises (ENT_IOB "B") and the # rest of that person (ENT_IOB "I"), so that it extends one entity without # running into a person who follows it titles <- c("dr", "dr.", "prof", "prof.") as_entity_patterns(list(   label = "PERSON",   pattern = list(list(LOWER = list(IN = titles)),                  list(ENT_TYPE = "PERSON", ENT_IOB = "B"),                  list(ENT_TYPE = "PERSON", ENT_IOB = "I", OP = "*")) )) #> Entity patterns: 1 pattern (PERSON: 1) #>   PERSON  [LOWER in (dr, dr., prof, prof.)] [ENT_TYPE = PERSON, ENT_IOB = B] [ENT_TYPE = PERSON, ENT_IOB = I]*  # }  # combine sets of patterns c(as_entity_patterns(c(ORG = "Globex")),   as_entity_patterns(c(PERSON = "Jane Smith"))) #> Entity patterns: 2 patterns (ORG: 1, PERSON: 1) #>   ORG     "Globex" #>   PERSON  "Jane Smith"
